data.title: 矢来美羽 · 摊位前的选择
data.description: 夜市摊位摆着两种颜色的手工饰品。美羽拿起其中一枚，认真看了看。
data.action: 美羽拿起其中一枚，认真看了看
data.promptProse: Strolling through a bustling summer festival promenade at night, Miu holds up a red paper lantern with a cheerful smile. Warm festival lanterns and colorful stalls line the path behind her, creating a lively evening atmosphere.
data.animaCaption: Standing along the lively night festival promenade, she holds up a glowing red paper lantern and turns with a cheerful, playful smile. Strings of warm lanterns and colorful market stalls brighten the summer evening behind her.
